UI_TWF_BF_SLIDER_DEPENDS_HINT: Sliders only work when feature above is enabled.
UI_TWF_BF_USE_TWF_AIMDIST_TT: Enable the Better Fishing override for cast/aim distance. When enabled, the Aim Distance slider below sets the maximum tiles.
UI_TWF_BF_USE_TWF_SHORE_TT: Enable a lighter, smaller-radius shore detection. When enabled, the Shore Radius slider below defines the search radius.
UI_TWF_BF_USE_TWF_SIZE_TT: Enable near-shore size redistribution for bites. When enabled, Near-Shore Blend below controls how strong the effect is.
UI_TWF_BF_USE_TWF_TEMP_TT: Enable a temperature coefficient for fishing. When enabled, Temperature Bonus/Malus below adjusts the multiplier.
UI_TWF_BF_USE_TWF_WEATHER_TT: Enable weather coefficients (fog, wind, rain). When enabled, each weather slider below adjusts its impact.
UI_TWF_BF_USE_TWF_TIME_TT: Enable bonus time windows (morning/evening). When enabled, the start/end sliders and bonus multiplier below are applied.
UI_TWF_BF_USE_TWF_SIZETABLES_TT: Switch to Better Fishing catch-chance tables (skill size limits and distribution). Requires reload of your savegame.
UI_TTF_BF_Status_BonusTime_TT:
Bonus Time
Green: You are currently inside the configured fishing bonus time window.
White: You are outside the bonus time window.
UI_TTF_BF_Status_Shore_TT:
Shore Detection
Red: Your current aim position is detected as near shore.
White: Your current aim position is not near shore.
UI_TTF_BF_Status_Weather_TT:
Weather Detection
Green: Current weather improves fishing.
White: Current weather has no effect.
Red: Current weather makes fishing worse.
UI_TTF_BF_Status_Bait_TT:
Bait Detection
Green: Your equipped fishing rod has valid bait attached.
Red: Your equipped fishing rod has no valid bait attached.
UI_options_TTF_BetterFishing_disableStat: Disables the icon-only fishing status UI when a fishing rod is equipped.
UI_options_TTF_BetterFishing_statusUISca: Changes the size of the fishing status UI.
